messages:
sasha: heads up — noticed weird billing on a long-running stream that sent tiny "trickle" chunks and then triggered a toolcall. charges look like partial tokens + full toolcall after truncation. anyone seen this pattern? :thinking:
joel: hmm can you paste logs/snippets? is this the reconnect/replay path or a simple retry?
sasha: quick log extract:
```
INFO 2026-03-17T14:02:11Z session=abc123 STREAM_CHUNK size=2 offset=102 ack=102
INFO 2026-03-17T14:02:14Z session=abc123 STREAM_CHUNK size=1 offset=103 ack=103
WARN 2026-03-17T14:02:16Z session=abc123 TOOLCALL start id=tc-9 truncation=prefix
INFO 2026-03-17T14:02:17Z session=abc123 STREAM_RESUME replay_from=101 replay_size=3
INFO 2026-03-17T14:02:18Z billing provisional_tokens=3 toolcall_charge=1
ERROR 2026-03-17T14:02:19Z billing finalized_tokens=6
```
(sorry formatted messy)
maria: looks like two things: 1) resume is re-emitting a small suffix that had been provisionally counted, and 2) toolcall billing records are tied to the truncation event instead of the final session confirmation. result: provisionals get double-counted when session finalizes.
ryan: do we have distinct provisional vs confirmed token ledger entries? i thought we were marking provisional but then reconciling via ack window.
maria: we do, but current reconcile logic assumes contiguous replay. the trickle pattern (many 1-2 token chunks) + immediate toolcall -> truncation makes reconciliation edge-case. the broker sets provisional for each chunk, then on resume we replay same tokens and mark them confirmed again without dedupe.
joel: can we reproduce with a small unit test? i can craft a harness to send: 1) open stream, 2) send chunks of 1-2 tokens with tiny gaps, 3) trigger toolcall mid-stream, 4) simulate network hiccup/resume.
sasha: repro steps (internal API):
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api/v1/sessions -d '{"model":"xlarge","mode":"stream"}'
# send: "a" (1 token) -> ack
# send: "b" (2 tokens) -> ack
# issue toolcall -> truncation path
# simulate resume: client reconnect + server replay
```
ryan: quick thought — we should ensure replayed tokens have same provisional id and we dedupe when confirming. also toolcall ledger entries should be attached to the final session id, not the intermediate truncation marker.
maria: agreed. two small fixes: 1) attach provisional tokens to session+provisional-id and check dedupe on confirm; 2) change toolcall billing to be provisional until session_final or explicit toolcall_confirmation event.
joel: sounds good. downside: UI/console needs to surface provisional vs confirmed to avoid noisy alerts for SRE/finance.
sasha: true — console currently shows finalized numbers only, which hides provisional churn. can we add a per-session provisional column in the console table? @billing-bot any thoughts on reporting impact?
billing-bot: auto-report: last 24h provisional spikes observed on sessions with avg_chunk_size <= 3 tokens. sample rate: 2.1% of streaming sessions. tagging label: stream-trickle.
ryan: OK I'll start a PR for the dedupe+provisional flag in the ledger service. joel can you own the repro test and a small e2e? maria can you handle the toolcall billing change + console flag?
joel: yep -- will push a unit/e2e by EOD tomorrow.
maria: will sketch console mockups and an API change doc. will also add a note to rollouts to gate on metric: provisional_to_final_ratio < 1.2 for two weeks.
sasha: perfect. created issue ENG-PLAT-1942 and linked this thread. cc @ryan for review when PR lands. thanks all :thumbsup:
